conviction_note: The FY26 numbers are mostly visible from the monthly KPIs and the Q3 tanshin and land near plan and the IFIS consensus. The move turns on the FY27 guide, the first mid-term plan (A-tie Plan 2029) and the dividend, all released together at about 15:30 today. I hold no sourced number for any of them, so p_up 49 and abs_move 8 (raised from the 5.78 proxy because a new-year guide and a first mid-term plan land together; this name's true prints moved +15.3, -14.4, +5.8 and -5.2). The findings sum to -0.2 and the scaled number is -0.16. The two agree, and both are an honest near-zero.
bar: IFIS consensus for FY2026/8: sales 3,470, OP 860, ordinary 900, NI 550 (JPY m), per kabuyoho as of 2026-10-14, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=369A. Company plan: 3,415 / 859 / 856 / 569, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714593643.pdf. Monex/IFIS put the plan's ordinary profit 5.9% below consensus, https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/369A_20260715_act_20260715_153034_12. There is no sourced FY27 consensus, so the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-14: no disclosed position of 0.5% or more (0.0, unchanged), https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html. Margin ratio 2054x in the baseline. Search snippets (snippet_only, July data) put margin longs at about 205-237k shares against zero margin shorts, roughly 20 days of turnover: a crowded leveraged retail long. No option skew exists. The stock is down from 2,800 (2026-09-24) to about 2,504 into the print, -3.0% over 20 sessions and -6.5% over 5. priced_lean_pct is -1.50, almost all of it margin overhang.

findings.finding: The monthly KPIs show plots sold at +18.6% (Jun), +18.2% (Jul) and +18.5% (Aug) year on year, 'at the year's average pace', with a strong August close ('決算期末の仕上げとして全社を挙げて'). Against last year's Q4 sales of 757, that implies Q4 sales of about 895-910 and FY sales of about 3,490-3,505: a small beat on the plan (3,415) and on IFIS (3,470).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 (2026-07-15): sales +22% and OP +38% year on year, 進捗 caught up with the standard pace, and the stock fell 5.2% the next day. This name has sold its in-line beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the monthly KPIs are public. The residual is the revenue-recognition gap between plots sold and booked sales. If the market had fully reflected a beat on plan, the stock would not have fallen 10% from its 2026-09-24 high into the print.
findings.independence: July KPI https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260807/140120260807513763.pdf and June KPI https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594479.pdf. Same company series, so not independent.

findings.finding: Q4 is this company's lowest-margin quarter (OP margin 8.4% in Q4 FY24 and 14.9% in Q4 FY25, against 24-34% in other quarters), and the unchanged plan needs Q4 OP of 213 (about 23% margin, +88% year on year). Amortisation of long-term prepaid costs is also rising faster than sales (108 in Q3 vs 80, +35%, against sales +22%) as openings accelerate. So OP risks a small miss against plan and IFIS (860); ordinary profit (9M non-operating +52, including a settlement receipt) should land near IFIS's 900.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 (2026-01-14, OP down year on year, 179 vs 205): -14.4% the next day. That is the one time OP growth disappointed.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The quarterly table is in the Q3 deck, and kabutan computed the required Q4 (+45% ordinary profit) on 2026-07-15. What the market may not hold is Q4's cost loading (bonus accrual) against a plan that assumes a normal-margin Q4. IFIS consensus has sat at 900 for four weeks unchanged, so nobody has marked it down.
findings.independence: kabutan Q3 article https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=369A&b=k202607150046 computes the same required Q4. It reads the same document, so it counts once.

findings.finding: The September 2026 KPI, the first month of FY27, was weak: new contracts down 164 month on month, contract rate 48.3% (-8.1pt year on year), referral rate 62.9% (-10.9pt). Plots sold were still +17.8% year on year. The company blames typhoons and weather.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior monthly KPI miss to compare. Since the 2026-10-07 release the stock has gone from about 2,695 to 2,504 (-7%), with a heavy-volume -3.4% day on 10-14.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced (the series is public, LESSONS rule 1). It is filed only because it may make management's FY27 guide more cautious. The -7% drift since 10-07 is what pricing it looks like.

findings.finding: The results come with the FY27 guide AND the first mid-term plan 'A-tie Plan 2029', confirmed for 2026-10-15 by the company's 2026-09-30 notice. The company's own stated aims are double-digit sales growth and an OP margin of 20-25%, a band at or below FY26's roughly 24-25% run rate. That implies FY27 OP growth no faster than sales, against an IFIS consensus that sat 4-6% above the company plan all year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last full-year print (2025-10-15, 15:30): the FY26 guide came in 3.1% above IFIS ordinary profit (Monex), and the stock rose 15.3% the next day (2,940 to 3,390) and went on to 3,950 within a week.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody can price a guide that does not exist yet. There is no sourced FY27 consensus and no rating coverage (kabuyoho shows zero analysts with ratings). The sign is an inference from the 20-25% margin aim (Q3 deck FAQ Q8, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715593804.pdf), so it is sized small inside a wide band. If the market expected a cautious guide, the stock would trade below its 1,991 June low at 18.6x PER; it does not.
findings.independence: Amortisation is growing faster than sales (Q3 deck datasheet, same document) and points the same way. Last year's guide above IFIS (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/369A_20251015_act_20251015_153054_5) points the other way.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns are likely to rise. The company commits to a payout ratio of 40% or more, 'continuously expanded' (Q3 deck), and introduced a 株主優待 on 2026-05-20. At the last full-year print it paid 46 against a 38.05 forecast. A FY27 dividend at 40% of a +10-15% EPS guide implies about 58-62 yen against 54 for FY26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-10-15 full-year print raised the dividend (38.05 to 46) alongside a guide above consensus: +15.3%. The two cannot be separated.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the policy is public. The upside is a payout increase or a new return policy inside the mid-term plan, which the deck hints at ('株主還元は継続的に拡充を検討'). The 2.16% forecast yield shows the market has not capitalised a larger return.
findings.independence: kabutan financial table showing the FY25 dividend raised from 38.05 to 46 at the full-year print, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=369A

findings.finding: Leveraged retail is crowded long into the print: margin longs of about 205-237k shares (July snippets; baseline margin ratio 2054x), zero margin shorts, about 20 days of average turnover. A disappointment has sellers and there is no short-covering fuel.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 (2026-01-14) fell 14.4% on 365k shares, about six times normal volume, with this margin overhang in place.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely already in the baseline's priced lean (margin_overhang -1.66), so it is filed small. It is an amplifier of a negative surprise, not a direction by itself.

findings.finding: A temple partnership (花光院, Noda) was terminated in July 2026. H1 booked a 110m impairment alongside a 79m settlement receipt, the same pattern. A Q4 impairment of the prepaid construction cost at that temple could hit net profit, which is already guided at 569 against IFIS 550.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 impairment (2026-04-14 print) was followed by +5.8%: one-offs below OP have not moved this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Not in any consensus line. But it sits below operating income and has no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.

outside_window.finding: The results and mid-term plan briefing (Investment Bridge, online) is on Saturday 2026-10-17, after the exit close. Any Q&A colour lands after the window.

release_time_source: The prior full-year (2025-10-15), Q2 (2026-04-14) and Q3 (2026-07-15) tanshin were all stamped 15:30 on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=369A) and Monex (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/369A_20260715_act_20260715_153034_12). Q1 was 18:00. The date was confirmed by the company's 2026-09-30 notice. Expected at or after the close, so the window is the 10-15 close to the 10-16 close.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed. FY26 ends here, so the print is the actual against plan 856 / IFIS 900 ordinary, likely near both. Returns: a FY27 dividend increase is likely under the 40%+ payout policy, and a payout change is possible inside the mid-term plan. New-year guide: FY27 guide plus the first mid-term plan, A-tie Plan 2029. This is the decider, with no sourced consensus. Quarter: 9M 進捗 was 81.5% on ordinary profit against 84.5% a year earlier; Q4 is seasonally the weakest-margin quarter.
baseline_tension: The findings net slightly negative, in line with the margin-overhang lean (-1.5) and the -6.5% five-day run-down. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY27 guide above IFIS plus a dividend increase or payout upgrade in the new mid-term plan, the exact combination that produced +15.3% at last year's full-year print. I looked for it and found the policy (payout of 40% or more, 'continuously expanded', a new 優待) but no number. The tension is therefore unresolved and p_up stays at 49.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a public series moves toward 0): the weak September KPI went from -0.3 to -0.1, and the Q4 OP-margin inference, computable from the Q3 deck, went from -0.4 to -0.2. The sales finding from the same public KPIs went from +0.3 to +0.2 for symmetry.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. The guidance finding, an inference from the 20-25% margin aim, went from -0.8 to -0.4; the impairment inference from -0.2 to -0.1; the positioning finding, which merely agrees with the priced lean, from -0.3 to -0.2.
